finding.evidence: Set-Cookie: session=admin-7c9e; Path=/ (no HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite)
finding.description: The session cookie can be read by script and sent cross-site.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: insecure-cookie (The session cookie can be read by script and sent cross-site. Evidence: Set-Cookie: session=admin-7c9e; Path=/ (no HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite)). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Concrete fix: change session Set-Cookie to include all three attributes and serve only over HTTPS: Set-Cookie: session=<value>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict (use SameSite=Lax only if Strict breaks top-level navigation). OWASP WSTG defines the most secure form as __Host-SID with path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict.

sources.contribution: HttpOnly is an extra attribute that can be added to the Set-Cookie HTTP response header
The purpose of the secure attribute is to prevent cookies from being observed by unauthorized parties due to the transmission of the cookie in clear text
the most secure cookie attribute configuration includes SameSite=Strict

verification.claim: HttpOnly is an extra attribute that can be added to the Set-Cookie HTTP response header
verification.detail: HttpOnly is an extra attribute that can be added to the Set-Cookie HTTP response header.

verification.claim: The purpose of the secure attribute is to prevent cookies from being observed by unauthorized parties due to the transmission of the cookie in clear text
verification.detail: The purpose of the secure attribute is to prevent cookies from being observed by unauthorized parties due to the transmission of the cookie in clear text.

verification.claim: the most secure cookie attribute configuration includes SameSite=Strict
verification.detail: Putting all this together, we can define the most secure cookie attribute configuration as: Set-Cookie: __Host-SID=<session token>; path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict .

fix.summary: Add HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict to the session cookie.
fix.risk: Secure cookies need HTTPS to be sent by browsers and Strict may block top-level cross-site navigation.
